status: Instructional film. Phone approval was not filmed; setup sound and approved enrollment come from separate recorded takes.
editorial_note: Only genuine supplied captures are shown. Setup transfer is a clean production recording. The subsequent b270 approval chapter is explicitly labeled an earlier recorded take. The phone step is an instruction card.

scenes.title:
From setup
to your first reply.
scenes.instruction:
Real hardware and Hub captures.
Synthesized narration and demo speech.
Several takes; waits edited. Phone approval shown as instructions.
scenes.narration: This walkthrough uses real Playdate and Hub captures. Narration and the demonstration speech are synthesized. Waiting periods are edited.

scenes.title:
A private build.
Your own Playdate.
scenes.instruction:
Build with --setup-only and your OpenAI key.
Copy Evener.pdx to Games in USB Data Disk mode.
Eject the disk, then open Evener.
scenes.narration: Build Evener in setup-only mode with your own OpenAI key. Keep that bundle private. Use USB Data Disk mode to copy Evener dot P D X into Games, then eject and open it.

scenes.title:
Open
Receive setup.
scenes.instruction: A setup-only installation starts here. On an existing installation, use the system menu, then Actions.
scenes.narration: Open Receive setup. On an existing installation, find it under Actions in the system menu.

scenes.title: Use a reachable Hub address.
scenes.instruction:
Settings / Mobile app / Pair using sound

Choose Tailscale, then create the invitation.
scenes.narration: In the Hub, open Settings, Mobile app, then Pair using sound. Check the Hub address, choose Tailscale, and create an invitation.

scenes.title: Let the Playdate hear the setup sound.
scenes.instruction: Actual room recording. Keep the Playdate near the speaker and let the sound finish.
scenes.narration: Play the setup sound beside your Playdate.

scenes.title:
Authorize with
your phone.
scenes.instruction:
Scan the Tailscale sign-in QR on your Playdate.
Sign in and authorize the device on the Hub’s tailnet.
This capture did not record the phone approval.
scenes.cue: INSTRUCTIONAL STEP · PHONE APPROVAL NOT RECORDED
scenes.narration: If enrollment is needed, scan the Tailscale code on the Playdate. On your phone, sign in and authorize the device on the Hub’s tailnet. Phone approval was not recorded.

scenes.title: Match every group on all four lines.
scenes.instruction: Earlier recorded take. Compare the complete code on your own screens, then approve in the Hub.
scenes.narration: This approval example is from an earlier take. Compare all four lines on your own screens. When every group matches, approve in the Hub.

scenes.title: Keep the Playdate connected.
scenes.instruction: The Hub confirms approval. Leave the device connected while setup finishes.
scenes.narration: The Hub confirms approval. Keep the Playdate connected.

scenes.title:
Review.
Press A to save.
scenes.instruction: Check the Hub address and connection shown on the Playdate. A saves this destination; B cancels.
scenes.narration: Review the destination on the Playdate, then press A to save it. The client connects and opens your sessions.

scenes.title:
Choose a
conversation.
scenes.instruction: Use the crank or D-pad to select a session. Press A to open it.
scenes.narration: Select a session with the crank or D-pad, then press A to open it.

scenes.title:
Hold A.
Start speaking.
scenes.instruction: Capture starts as soon as you hold A. Captions appear as transcription becomes ready.
scenes.narration: Hold A and start speaking immediately. The microphone captures your words.

scenes.title:
Release A.
Read your words.
scenes.instruction: Wait for the saved final text. Review it before sending.
scenes.narration: Release A to finish recording. Wait for the final text to be saved, then read it. The message has not been sent yet.

scenes.title:
A separate
press to send.
scenes.instruction: Press A again to send the reviewed message to this session.
scenes.narration: Press A separately to send the reviewed message. An active session receives it in its queue.

scenes.title:
Read the reply.
Crank to scroll.
scenes.instruction: The test reply is small screen big ideas. The conversation stays available to read.
scenes.narration: The reply appears in the conversation. Use the crank to read through it. This is the recorded test exchange.

scenes.title:
Small screen.
Big ideas.
